limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the final attempt; this artifact audit certifies only the headless current Appearance lane (79 checks, the state after the review).

The preceding-host control (56 normative failures), the host from before the shared callback (9) and the retained emit-every-callback sabotage (17 failures of the first 67 checks) remain local evidence; this audit only shows that every check they fail and still exist passes in the hosted run. The report's top level and its first review rerun describe earlier trees; the hosted run exercises the state of the second review rerun.
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply:
The headless DisplayServer has no system theme: the system scheme comes from a validation meta and the change is delivered through the Callable the module registers with DisplayServer.
Real OS theme changes on macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iOS are not executed.
DisplayServer keeps one system theme callback: a game that registers its own replaces Fabric's, or is replaced by it, whichever registers last.
Accent and base colors, PlatformColor/DynamicColorIOS, per-window themes and Godot mobile exports are not covered.
No whole GF, checkpoint, dependency, weight or denominator closed.
